subject: POC kickoff: hybrid site/virtual handoff — room access & load plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@optichain.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@optichain.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff: logistics & preferred format

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week — OptiChain is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We'd like to schedule a kickoff that combines a short on-site session (small team) plus a virtual component for our broader product group. High-level goals: prompt review, routing scenarios, and a short load ramp to validate throughput for typical routing bursts.

Preferred window: Oct 20–22 (we're US-based, PT works best). On-site attendees: myself (Liam), Priya Sharma (PM), and one SRE (Tariq H.). We'll need visitor access for badges, an AV-enabled room (hybrid), and confirmation about screen-sharing/recording policy. Also, can Redwood run a limited load test (100 qps burst, 10s ramps) during the session, or should we do that outside business hours?

Attached: OptiChain-PoC-Overview.pdf (high level).

Can you propose times and confirm what you need from our side?

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, OptiChain Logistics
liam@optichain.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@optichain.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@optichain.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: logistics & preferred format

Hi Liam / Priya,

Great — happy to run the hybrid kickoff. Proposed session: Oct 21, 10:00–14:00 PT. Rough agenda: 10:00 intro & goals, 10:20 prompt walkthrough, 11:00 routing scenarios & KV cache discussion, 12:00 lunch break, 12:30 hands-on prompt tuning + routing load ramp (target: 100 qps initial), 13:30 wrap & next steps.

Questions / asks for you:
- Confirm on-site headcount (names for badges).
- Are there any IP/PII items we should know about before recording? We typically ask customers to sign a short recording consent form; if you'd rather limit recording, we can mark the session as non-publish and provide the recording only to OptiChain legal.
- For load tests: 100 qps bursts are fine for the hands-on segment if you confirm traffic shape. We'll run the ramp during the session but can also schedule a controlled off-hours run if you prefer.

Monica and Markus — can you check room availability for Oct 21 (hybrid room with dual-screen & Zoom room link) and arrange visitor badges? I'd like AV tech on-site by 9:30 to validate mics/camera and that the recording permission toggle is set per OptiChain preference. Attaching a proposed agenda and the access checklist.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood-inference.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood-inference.com>

Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 16:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: OptiChain Oct 21 — room booking + AV + badges (please)

Monica / Markus,

Can you own logistics for Oct 21 (10:00–14:00 PT) for the OptiChain kickoff? Key items:
- Reserve Hybrid Room 2 (capacity 8) and enable Zoom passthrough + dual screens.
- AV tech on-site at 09:30; confirm recorder settings and whether we can mark recording private and share only with optichain@legal.
- Visitor badges for Liam O'Connor, Priya Sharma, and Tariq H (full names to follow when they confirm).
- Put the access_instructions.pdf and room-req-form in the calendar invite.
- Network: please whitelist three OptiChain IPs for the load window and coordinate with infra (I'll send IPs once they confirm).

Attachments: room-req-form.pdf (internal).

If Hybrid Room 2 is already booked, offer Hybrid Room 1 (larger) and confirm parking passes.

Thanks — Hannah
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@optichain.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@optichain.com>, Legal Team <legal@optichain.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: logistics & preferred format

Hi Hannah,

Oct 21 works for us. On-site attendees confirmed: Liam O'Connor, Priya Sharma, Tariq Hassan (SRE). Attendee list attached (optichain_attendee_list.csv).

Recording: OptiChain is fine with the session being recorded for internal review but we need the recording to be shared only with our Legal team (legal@optichain.com) and product leads. Please redact or avoid capturing any customer PII — we'll highlight any test prompts that contain sensitive tokens ahead of time.

Load test: 100 qps burst with a 10s ramp is fine for the hands-on segment. We ask that you run the ramp once during the session and that you monitor latency; if latency climbs above 350ms P50, pause the ramp and fallback to a lower QPS. If weekends are safer for a full stress run, we can schedule that later.

Two asks:
1) Please send visitor badge instructions and parking details.
2) Please make sure the Zoom cloud recording is disabled for auto-publish and that the file is staged to a private Drive folder.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Sharma
Product Lead, OptiChain

Notes / commitments:

Redwood legal will send a short recording consent form; if you prefer, we can mark the meeting as "no public record" and only keep the private file for the two-week post-POC review.
- AV tech on-site at 09:30 to confirm mics/camera and run a quick recorder test.
- We'll start the 100 qps ramp at ~12:30 PT; infra will monitor P50 and pause if P50 > 350ms.
